Title: Azure invoices emailed directly to your inbox

Body.Content:
Instead of downloading your invoice every month, you can now opt in to have your invoice attached to your monthly billing email. In addition, you can configure more recipients for this email. Save time and send the invoice directly to your accounts receivable department.

To opt in, select your subscription from the Subscriptions blade. You have to opt in for each subscription you own. Select Send my invoice (you might not see this if you're not the account admin), and then select Opt In.

Learn more about this feature on the Azure blog.
